el.Me acerco al espacio habitual del pacien: I come to the patient's own space: their home, an institution, or wherever the treatment makes the most sense. I bring the materials I choose for each person.
el.CABA y Zona Norte: Buenos Aires City and the North Zone

el.Cada tratamiento se construye de manera: Each treatment is built in its own way, according to each person's history, interests and needs.
el.Sesiones en el espacio habitual del paci: Sessions in the patient's own space, especially suited to cases of limited mobility, particular needs, or when home is the best place to do the work.

There is no single way to offer support. The space, the resources and the format are built together with each person.
el.Me escribís por WhatsApp, me contás la s: You write to me on WhatsApp, tell me about your situation, and we arrange a first interview.
el.Conozco a la persona, su historia, sus g: I get to know the person: their story, their tastes, their needs, and what they hope to get from the therapy. When appropriate, I also meet their family.
el.Armo una propuesta que puede incluir jue: I put together a proposal that may include play, art, materials, and activities chosen for that particular person.
el.Entrevistas con la familia, intercambio: Interviews with the family, exchange with other professionals and with the school, and external supervision of my work, as part of the ethical practice of the profession.
el.Soy psicóloga y docente. Hace más de 30: I am a psychologist and teacher. For more than 30 years I have worked in education and psychotherapy with children, adolescents, young people, and adults, with and without disabilities. I also support older adults, and I have experience with people hospitalized with serious illnesses and in palliative care.

el.¿En qué zonas atendés a domicilio?: Which areas do you cover for home visits?
el.Principalmente en la Ciudad de Buenos Ai: Mainly the City of Buenos Aires and the northern suburbs (Zona Norte). If you live elsewhere, write to me and we'll see what's possible.
el.Sí, cuando la persona lo prefiere y la s: Yes, when the person prefers it and the situation allows. Guidance for families and students can also be done online.
el.¿Cómo es la primera consulta?: What is the first consultation like?
el.Empezamos con entrevistas iniciales para: We begin with initial interviews to get to know the person, their story, and what they need. From there, we decide together on the format and frequency.
el.¿Trabajás con la familia y con otros pro: Do you work with the family and with other professionals?
el.Sí. Según cada caso, el tratamiento pued: Yes. Depending on the case, the therapy may include family interviews and exchange with other health professionals and with the school.
el.¿Qué materiales usás en las sesiones?: What materials do you use in sessions?
el.Elijo los materiales según los intereses: I choose materials according to each patient's interests and abilities: games, art, cognitive stimulation activities, and other resources. The point isn't to make “something pretty,” but to open up other ways of expressing oneself.
